headline: Animal rights group PETA call for Crystal Palace to retire bald eagle mascot
description: Animal rights group PETA has urged Crystal Palace to retire the club's bald eagle mascot, Phoenix, with immediate effect.

headline: Cesc Fàbregas calls suggestions he could replace Michael Carrick at Man United disrespectful
description: Cesc Fabregas has dismissed suggestions he could be in line to replace Michael Carrick as disrespectful.

headline: Morgan Rogers: João Pedro's 'hunger' to score makes everyone at Chelsea better
description: Morgan Rogers feels João Pedro is at the height of his powers and has hailed his in-form teammate's "hunger to score" for Xabi Alonso's Chelsea.

headline: James Maddison apologises to Coventry fans for Tottenham goal celebration
description: James Maddison has apologised to the Coventry City fans for his goal celebration on Monday night.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Premier League clubs eye Alexander-Arnold amid Real Madrid uncertainty
description: Real Madrid defender Trent Alexander-Arnold is considering his future at the Bernabéu, with Liverpool, Chelsea, Arsenal and Man City monitoring his situation. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: A global experiment: Can ESPN predict the Ballon d'Or awards?
description: The Ballon d'Or awards are typically tough to predict, but can ESPN and our global resources do just that?
